description: This file defines API endpoints for user authentication, including registration, login, logout, profile retrieval, and profile updating using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It includes route definitions, request/response schemas, and audit logging.

methods.name: UserOut register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles registration of a new user, checks for existing email, hashes password, creates user, records audit log.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user with email and password, creates JWT token, records login audit.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] logout(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Records logout audit; stateless JWT logout.

methods.name: UserOut get_profile(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns profile data for the authenticated user.

methods.name: UserOut update_profile( payload: ProfileUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Updates user's profile fields and records audit log.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: logout
ctags.pattern: /^def logout(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dic/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^def register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserOut:$/

ctags.name: update_profile
ctags.signature: ( payload: ProfileUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
